'''2009 Match Play Championship Day 2 Dan Kim DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Dan Kim]] at [[2009 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Mystril Racing
* '''Username:''' MrNiceGuy
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
